description: Phase 2 Action+Intent annotation schema v0. Action = WHAT changed (multi-label coarse + fine). Intent = WHY (single-label, orthogonal to action).

coarse_actions._doc: 10 + other coarse action categories. Multi-label: pick ALL that apply.
coarse_actions.data: Data loading, cleaning, encoding, type conversion, missing value handling, dataset adapter
coarse_actions.features: Feature engineering, feature selection, transformations, text vectorization
coarse_actions.model: Architecture or backbone swap, add/remove layers, head modification, pretrained weight change
coarse_actions.training: Training config: optimizer, loss, scheduler, learning rate, regularization, epochs, batch size, hparams
coarse_actions.ensemble: Model combination: add/remove members, weight adjustment, stacking/blending changes
coarse_actions.validation: CV scheme, evaluation metric, fold strategy, split logic changes
coarse_actions.inference: Prediction pipeline, post-processing, TTA, threshold tuning, submission format
coarse_actions.infra: Environment, imports, paths, GPU config, IO, dependencies, seed, logging
coarse_actions.housekeeping: Debug fix, syntax fix, code restructure, cosmetic cleanup, noop, revert
coarse_actions.other: Doesn't fit any above — MUST provide other_action_note with proposed_tag + description

intent_categories._doc: 6 + other intent categories. List 1-2 intents (primary first). Most transitions need only 1.
intent_categories.exploration: Trying something qualitatively new (new model family, new feature type, new approach, building first pipeline)
intent_categories.optimization: Refining an existing approach (tuning hparams, adjusting weights, ensemble tweaks, late-stage polishing)
intent_categories.pivoting: Abandoning current direction for a fundamentally different one (major rewrite, fork adoption)
intent_categories.debugging: Fixing errors, crashes, regressions, reverting broken changes
intent_categories.restructuring: Refactoring, cleanup, reorganizing code with no functional change
intent_categories.verification: Minimal or zero code change, running to check score or test submission
intent_categories.other: Doesn't fit any above — MUST provide other_intent_note with proposed_tag + description

confidence_doc: high = explicit code evidence (clear diff hunk), mid = strong contextual inference, low = ambiguous or indirect
magnitude_doc: micro = <5 lines changed, cosmetic; minor = localized change to one component; major = significant change to multiple components; overhaul = near-complete rewrite or fork adoption
score_effect_doc: Based on score_old vs score_new. improving = score got better, plateau = no meaningful change, regressing = score got worse, unknown = no linked scores

output_format.goal_nl: string (one sentence: what was the author trying to achieve)
output_format.diff_summary: string (one sentence: what concretely changed in the code)
output_format.other_action_note: null or {proposed_tag: string, parent: string, description: string}

design_principles: Action (WHAT) and Intent (WHY) are orthogonal: same action can serve different intents, same intent can involve different actions
Actions are multi-label (a diff can touch model + training); Intents are 1-2 labels (primary first, most transitions need only 1)
both have 'other' escape hatches with mandatory proposed_tag + description for LLM discovery
Fine actions are closed-list + other_<parent> with confidence, following Phase 1 pattern
Intent confidence: high = clear from diff, mid = reasonable inference, low = genuinely ambiguous
